title: Which AI Model Should You Use for Which Task?
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: A good harness manufactures verifiability the raw task didn't have - and every bit of verifiability you add lets you reach for a weaker model.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that the scaffolding around a model is as important as the model itself in determining which tier you need

quotes.text: Staff each task with the cheapest model that clears that bar, and save your architects for the handful where judgment really is the product.
quotes.why_it_matters: Encapsulates the economic principle: use strong judgment where it adds value, automate the rest
